route.name: Street approach
route.requiredOutcome: Player gets control, sees Blackwater House, hears the first Street That Listens cue, and understands the first goal.

route.name: Blackwater threshold
route.requiredOutcome: The threshold uses production composition, lighting, audio, and one authored interaction before entry.

route.name: First house investigation
route.requiredOutcome: Entry hall and first investigation room show inhabited history, current disturbance, and one optional secret.

route.name: First puzzle
route.requiredOutcome: A readable environmental puzzle uses hint tiers, feedback, reset safety, and accessibility equivalent.

route.name: First Bailiff search
route.requiredOutcome: Bailiff responds to evidence, searches last-known space, checks one hiding location, and exits without teleporting.

route.name: Fair attack or near-miss
route.requiredOutcome: Attack telegraph, active window, miss, and recovery can be observed and survived.

route.name: Secret and shortcut
route.requiredOutcome: One secret changes route knowledge and opens a meaningful shortcut.

route.name: Death and checkpoint recovery
route.requiredOutcome: Death or failure restores the checkpoint without duplicate Bailiff, audio, GUI, prompts, or stale objective state.

doNotStartBeforePhase222: No Golden Route environment production starts in Phase 221.
